newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's cement sector started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mexico's cement sector started.

text.p: HSBC James Capel brokerage began coverage recently of three companies in Mexico's cement industry, the brokerage said in a report on Tuesday.
It started Cemex SA and Grupo Cementos Chihuahua (GCC) with a buy rating and Apasco with a hold recommendation.
"We are cautious on full-year 1997 prospects despite a strong anticipated second quarter," the brokerage wrote.
It added that prices should improve moderately by the end of the year and that ready mix price and volume growth should outpace cement.

"Mexico's cement sector is continuing to recover from the 1994 peso devaluation," the report said. "We expect the sector, particularly Cemex and GCC, to outperform through year-end as the market further acknowledges the current low valuation levels."
Apasco's Mexico shares stood at 61.10 pesos each before trading on Tuesday. Cemex's shares stood at 40.95 pesos and GCC's at 9.86 pesos.
